note: Editable curation config for the Hot Sheet news rows. 'icons' is the at-a-glance icon map (lowest priority number wins; at most 'max' icons per row). 'rules' are case-insensitive regexes tested against a story's title and summary. 'tagMap' maps the curator's own tags (ticker.json tag/tags) to an icon key. 'hot' = how many sources make a story trending. 'new' = shown when the story wasn't on this device at your last visit and is at most newHours old. Change icons, wording or rules here; no code change needed. 'pinTopics' = stories matching 'match' get the 'boost' and a label chip and sit at the top (e.g. Stags day). 'suppressTopics' = stories matching 'match' are dropped from the feed (e.g. don't rehash Truce's own Ironman story). Both are regexes, case-insensitive.

new.label: New (not here at your last visit, under ~12h old)

trending.note: A story is 'hot' (forced to the top with the fire icon) when at least minSources different outlets ran it inside windowHours, or spikeSources outlets inside spikeHours, or it's a big Detroit / Michigan / MSU result.

scoresNote: Scoreboard rundown lines come from ESPN's public scoreboard JSON via tools/curate_ticker.py (scores-context.json). Detroit teams (Lions, Tigers, Pistons, Red Wings, Michigan, MSU) sort first.

concerts.note: Concert watch (tools/concert_watch.py). boostArtists: extra artists to chase even if not in rotation. suppressArtists: never show. venuePages: extra venue pages to read ({name,url,kind: jsonld|ics,venue,region}). Shows 30-180 days out are flagged 'plan'.
